food_beverage_category.label: Food / beverage category
food_beverage_category.value: Spices, herbs, seasoning mixes, condiments, hot sauces, mustard, and flavors for food manufacturers

brand_private_label_manufacturing.label: Brand / private-label manufacturing
brand_private_label_manufacturing.value: Owned consumer brands (McCormick, Frank's RedHot, Cholula, French's, Schwartz) plus custom flavor solutions for food manufacturers and foodservice

shelf_life_storage_condition.label: Shelf life / storage condition
shelf_life_storage_condition.value: Mostly shelf-stable spices, seasonings and sauces; some chilled herbs (Gourmet Garden) and frozen meals

processing_technology.label: Processing technology
processing_technology.value: Blending and packaging of spices and seasonings; flavor creation and extraction

temperature_controlled_logistics.label: Temperature-controlled logistics
temperature_controlled_logistics.value: Mainly ambient distribution; limited chilled for fresh-style herbs and frozen meals

customer_channel_sales_mix.label: Customer-channel sales mix
customer_channel_sales_mix.value: Two segments: consumer retail grocery sales and flavor solutions sales to food manufacturers, foodservice and restaurants

input_food_safety_exposure.label: Input / food-safety exposure
input_food_safety_exposure.value: Global sourcing of herbs, spices and agricultural raw materials, including regenerative agriculture sourcing regions
